title: Orion Summit — Sponsor fulfillment & ops playbook (v4)
content:
Context
- Sponsor package for Orion Summit (deal: ORION-2026-SS-03). This doc replaces the email-thread notes + fulfillment matrix v3 and consolidates the current operating plan + what we must ensure is in the SOW.
- Source of truth: this playbook + final SOW in DocuSign. If anything below conflicts with SOW, escalate before signing.

What changed since v3 (important deltas)
1) Stage demo slot
- Updated time (Orion confirmed 10/09): Friday 10:40–11:00 (main hall). Still a 20-minute slot.
- Format remains configurable: 15 min presentation + 5 min live Q&A (Q&A is included in the 20 minutes; no extra time).
- Practice: now includes (a) one dedicated 20-min practice slot with AV on Thursday, plus (b) optional 10-min walk-through earlier that day if schedule permits.

2) Lead retrieval + SLA
- Vendor changed: Orion is using “ExpoLeads” for badge scans (previously referenced as LeadCollect in early draft).
- Orion commit (must be in SOW): raw lead export (CSV) delivered within 12 hours after the final session on the last event day.
- Optional add-on (not purchased unless we explicitly approve): live sync into HubSpot.

3) Branding placement
- Confirmed inclusions:
  - Main stage backdrop (sponsor block)
  - Partner page (size: medium)
  - Mobile app hero rotation on event day
  - Countdown email placement: changed from “48-hour countdown email” to the “72-hour final logistics email” (Orion changed their cadence).
- Action: ensure creative team provides correct logo variant + safe margins (see Logo specs section).

4) Badges / passes
- Included credentials: 2 exhibitor badges + 1 speaker badge (unchanged).
- Additional staff passes: discounted rate still available, but Orion now requires purchase/registration by Oct 24 to guarantee printing.

5) Shipping + on-site labor
- Shipping deadline update:
  - Arrive-by to show warehouse: Oct 23 (previous draft said Oct 20).
  - Recommended ship-out from us: no later than Oct 19 to avoid carrier delays.
- We are hand-carrying the demo rack (no crate) to avoid handling fees.
- In-hall labor: Orion provides 1 “light install” labor window (up to 60 minutes) per exhibitor. Anything beyond that is billed.

Key commitments we require in the SOW (copy/paste ready)
- Lead export clause (final wording we want):
  “Sponsor will receive a raw lead export (CSV) for all scanned leads within twelve (12) hours after the final session concludes on the last day of the event.”
- Countdown email clause:
  “Sponsor logo will be included in the 72-hour final logistics email to all registered attendees, in addition to standard sponsor placements listed in the fulfillment matrix.”
- Practice slot clause:
  “Event will provide one dedicated rehearsal slot on the main stage with AV support (minimum 20 minutes) on the day prior to Sponsor’s presentation.”

Fulfillment summary (what Orion delivers)
- Stage demo
  - Slot: Fri 10:40–11:00
  - AV: single laptop HDMI input; lapel mic; house clicker available (bring our own as backup)
  - Staffing: stage manager on headset; Orion records session (confirm usage rights if we want raw video)
- Logo + brand placement
  - Main stage backdrop sponsor block
  - Partner page listing: medium
  - Mobile app hero rotation on event day
  - 72-hour final logistics email
- Leads
  - QR badge scan via ExpoLeads
  - Deliverable: CSV export within 12 hours post-event close
- Badges
  - 2 exhibitor + 1 speaker

Redwood internal owners (RACI-ish)
- Overall owner / sponsor interface: Diego
- On-site ops / shipping / printing: Evelyn
- Stage content + AV readiness: Marcus
- Lead ingestion + routing / CRM mapping: Aditya

Ops checklist (Redwood)
A) Stage demo prep (Marcus)
- Draft the run-of-show for 15 + 5 Q&A (7-step demo script).
- Build one-slide “failover” fallback (in case live demo fails).
- Confirm laptop requirements:
  - HDMI out (bring USB-C → HDMI dongle)
  - Disable sleep, notifications, auto-updates
  - Set resolution to match projector (test onsite)
- Bring backups:
  - Clicker
  - Offline video capture of demo (last resort)

B) AV + rehearsal scheduling (Marcus + Evelyn)
- Lock rehearsal time with Orion: Thursday dedicated 20-min slot (target: 4:00pm local; adjust if Orion confirms different time).
- Request: podium access + confidence monitor if available.

C) Shipping / onsite logistics (Evelyn)
- Hand-carry demo rack (no crate).
- Ship remainder to show warehouse (arrive-by Oct 23). Recommended ship-out: Oct 19.
- Pack list:
  - Two demo units labeled
  - Power strips + extension cords
  - Gaffer tape + zip ties
  - Printed one-pagers (or confirm venue print-on-demand)

D) Collateral (Evelyn + Diego)
- One-page summary (PDF + print-ready): due Oct 13.
- QR code on one-pager should point to:
  - Primary CTA landing page
  - Backup shortlink (in case tracking domain issues)

E) Lead flow / CRM (Aditya)
- Pre-map CSV fields from ExpoLeads → HubSpot properties.
- Build import recipe and a “Day 0” workflow:
  - Immediate acknowledgement email (if compliant)
  - Task creation for SDR follow-up
  - Segment by track / interest tags if provided
- Confirm ability to import within 2 hours of receiving CSV.

Open questions / to confirm with Orion (Diego)
- Confirm whether we can receive:
  - Timestamped scan data
  - Booth vs session scan source labels
  - Opt-in/consent fields included in the export
- Confirm if Orion provides session recording file and timeline for delivery.
- Confirm any restrictions on using Orion attendee list beyond scanned leads (assume restricted unless explicit).

Quick timeline (working)
- Oct 10: finalize SOW redlines + send to Orion
- Oct 13: collateral print-ready
- Oct 19: recommended ship-out
- Oct 23: warehouse arrive-by
- Oct 24: last day to order extra staff badges with print guarantee
- Thu (event-1): stage rehearsal + AV check
- Fri: stage demo (10:40–11:00)
- Post-event: lead CSV delivered within 12 hours; import + outbound within same day

Notes to self (Diego)
- Do not sign SOW until the lead-export SLA + 72-hour email placement + rehearsal language is explicitly included.
- If Orion pushes back on 12-hour SLA, fall back to 24 hours only if we also get (a) a partial export same-day and (b) confirmation of complete dataset the next morning.
